# Artifact fences (MARXY-235)

Diff, console, log, ANSI and long-line fixtures for the reader-artifacts handbook.

## Unified diff with a long added line

```diff
@@ -1,2 +1,3 @@
 context
+this is a very long added line that must wrap in the reader without looking like a new plus line because the continuation hangs past the one-character marker column and keeps the same tint xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
 context
\ No newline at end of file
```
